"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since March, the ruling class has used the pandemic crises to further the grip of capitalism on workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Since March, the ruling class has bailed out corporations while giving working-class people crumbs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Since March, the ruling class met national uprisings for Black lives with violence and ongoing dissent with vicious suppression.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Since March, the ruling class upheld sanctions that have decimated international relief efforts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Since March, the ruling class further disenfranchised voters through unsafe and inaccessible elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The ruling class is forcing a premature return to in-person learning in schools just as COVID-19 rates spike across the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The push to reopen schools by both major parties is an act of political violence.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Demand no reopening of schools until schools are safe for students and all staff.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
